title: All Expedition 33 Bosses by Area - Location Index
description: Every optional boss in Expedition 33 grouped by the area you find them in, with weaknesses and key drops inline. Find what you missed in each region.

sections.title: How to Use This Index
sections.content:
All optional bosses in Expedition 33, grouped by the area they are found in - so when you are exploring somewhere, you can see at a glance what you might have missed.

Each boss name links straight to its page. Weaknesses and key drops are shown inline so you can plan a loadout before travelling.

For a flat reward-only view, see our boss drops index. For the recommended order to fight them, see boss order.

sections.title: If a Boss Is Missing From Your Game
sections.content:
Two common reasons a boss is not where you expect it:

  • Movement ability gating. Several Continent bosses - Thunder Eveque, Frost Eveque and Serpenphare among them - are only reachable once Esquie has flight, and Scavenger needs swim.
  • Quest gating. Scavenger is locked behind the Lady of Sap quest, and Blanche's whole outcome depends on how you handled the friendly Nevron questline across Acts 1 and 2.

Golgra also has one permanently missable encounter: you must accept the Dark Gestral Arena challenge immediately after defeating the Chromatic Robust Sakapatate.
